description: Ball Butler body template for the sweep yaw-offset estimator (bb_calibration.estimate_sweep_yaw_offset): the seven yaw-stage markers (QTM labels Ball Butler - 1..7; the estimator ignores labels and matches by geometry), plus E(y), the gauge pin and the repeatability that travel with them.
frame: BB body frame, mm. Origin: the yaw axis point at world z = session A stored BB z (1734.86 mm) in the 7-sweep bag; z: the yaw axis (fitted from the 7 sweeps' rotations; world tilt 1.68 deg); x: toward QTM 4 (the retired anchor marker), perpendicular to the axis. The posed origin IS the published BB position.

E.basis: E(y) = e1*u + e2*u^2 + e3*u^3 deg, u = max(y, 0)/100, y = reported yaw in deg; E(0) = 0
E.meaning: physical minus reported yaw beyond the reported zero, MOVING relation, at fixed offset. Held fixed inside the estimator so the offset does not depend on the yaw range a window covers. NOT an aim correction: stationary holds relate differently by a few tenths.
E.provenance: Fitted 2026-10-09 on the 7 calibration sweeps of rosbag 2026-10-09_18-56-37 (cubic, per-sweep offset and lag, alternated with the lag fit; heartbeat yaw with the one-period-stale mixture). Residual 0.246 deg RMS.

gauge.pinned_on: session 20261009T002142_931068Z (A, 00:21): the estimator on A's own moving frames (throw slews, 5 10-minute windows, per-window lag 94-97 ms; the last, partial window excluded: template residual 0.64 mm > the gate's 0.5 mm, it read -0.134) reads raw_offset_at_pin_deg (window SD 0.028); A's stored offset 0.208 deg is the frame resources/throw_affine_correction.json was fitted in. So A reads 0.208 by construction.
gauge.repinned_on: 2026-10-11, from landings by the pre-registered rule (BallButler settle_yaw_gauge.py: >= 30 accepted corrected throws; |mean bearing| <= 0.15 deg confirms, else add the mean bearing to the pin): previous pin 0.208 deg (session A, above). Sitting 2026-10-10 23:34 local, session 20261010T123404_756897Z (range-weighted plan, 16 cells at 600/700 and 1450/1550 mm, bearings 10-38 deg, 48 throws): 47 accepted, node used 0.804 deg (base_frame), mean bearing -0.179 +/- 0.099 deg (SE), lateral -4.2 +/- 1.6 mm at mean range 1065 mm, rotation-vs-translation slope -0.50 +/- 0.21 deg, intercept +5.0 +/- 4.2 mm: RE_PIN by -0.179 -> 0.208 - 0.179 = 0.029 deg. Corroboration only (below the rule's 30 on its own): session 20261010T082544_262394Z (19:23, 28 accepted, used 0.790) reads -0.278 +/- 0.103; both pooled (75) -0.216 +/- 0.073. raw_offset_at_pin_deg is unchanged, so session A now reads 0.029 and every published offset and pooled BB-in-base kappa moves by -0.179 deg (kappa records keep their own pin_deg; bb_base_frame.pool_kappa moves them). In base_frame mode (bb_pose_source auto/base_frame, base seen) this needs no bb_moved (how_to_adjust's bb_moved step predates the base frame): the base gate compares like with like, and a bb_moved the gate does not consume stays armed. Confirm with one sweep, base seen: the node should report ~0.62-0.63 deg (offline replay of the sitting's own sweep: 0.8045 -> 0.6255 deg).
gauge.uncertainty: The pin transfers A's frame to within the SE of A's windows (0.012 deg). Session B through the same code reads 0.201 (B - A = -0.007). The 7-sweep bag (18:56) reads 0.448 (per-sweep SD 0.023): this estimator puts today's BB +0.24 deg from A's frame. The reinvestigation (bb_placement_reinvestigation_20261009/REPORT.md) found +0.4 +/- 0.2 deg across methods (+0.24..+0.6, body model +0.43), marker geometry and axis point unchanged, cause unidentified. So the pin is exact for A's frame, but whether the aim of today's BB wants ~0.45 (this estimator) or more is settled only by landings: take the pin as uncertain by +/- 0.2 deg until a validation sitting measures it.
gauge.how_to_adjust: After a validation sitting measures a mean bearing error implying an offset error delta (deg; positive = the offset should be larger), edit ONLY pinned_yaw_offset_deg: 0.208 -> 0.208 + delta. Everything else in this file stays. Then set mocap_node bb_moved:=true and recalibrate once, so the stored reference moves by the same delta.
gauge.rule: Valid for this mounting and this affine only. If BB is physically moved or QTM is recalibrated: set bb_moved:=true, calibrate, and refit throw_affine_correction.json (or re-pin from landings).

sigma.provenance: Out-of-sample per-sweep SD on the 7 sweeps of rosbag 2026-10-09_18-56-37: each sweep estimated with E refitted on the other six (leave-one-out). In-sample SD 0.023 deg. Published sigma = sqrt(formal_se^2 + repeatability^2).

provenance.template: Generalised Procrustes over labelled frames, yaw-balanced (<= 40 frames per 2-deg bin of lag-corrected yaw per bag): session A {"frames": 2941, "bins": 75, "yaw_range": [-0.0, 147.0]}, session B {"frames": 2950, "bins": 77, "yaw_range": [-0.4, 151.8]}, 7-sweep bag {"frames": 2520, "bins": 63, "yaw_range": [1.5, 125.5]} (its parked |y| < 1.5 deg frames excluded: non-rigid reconstruction there).
provenance.rigidity: per-marker RMS of the selected frames against the template 0.41-0.63 mm (A), 0.43-0.63 (B), 0.58-0.92 (7-sweep bag, moving)
